description: De facto Tech Lead and primary frontend owner for Postmark through major team transitions. Led the 10-month template editor initiative end to end, was technical lead for the billing platform migration, ran hiring and onboarding for engineers and contractors, and authored 30+ documentation pages.

Owned end-to-end initiatives to improve Customer Support efficiency. Delivered internal tools that contributed to cutting ticket reply times from 6 hours to 23 minutes company-wide, and designed a modular, parallel Playwright framework reaching about 95% coverage.

Built and maintained features for Blue Apron's web platform with a focus on compliance and data privacy. Integrated OneTrust, Segment and Google Tag Manager to enforce user consent preferences and ensure GDPR compliance.

Feature development and maintenance on a large-scale web platform built with Ruby on Rails and EmberJS. Reengineered a drag-and-drop onboarding component to improve usability within legacy EmberJS constraints.

Spearheaded the modernization from a Rails 4 and jQuery monolith to a Rails 6 API with a React frontend. Cut data table load times from over 20 seconds to under 8, and overhauled the translation system so new global customers could be onboarded within a week.

Designed the backend for a health tech video analysis platform: a Python and OpenCV solution for detection, counting and motility tracking, a Django REST API, and AWS Lambda pipelines for automated analysis, with CI/CD on AWS CodePipeline.
Mentored a group of 5 first-year students from remote regions through IntegraTEC, and presented projects at the TEC Vocational Fair and the TEC Emprende Lab.
